review_candidates.title: Senior Graphic Designer
review_candidates.description: 🚀  We're Hiring: Senior Graphic Designer 📍  Cairo, Egypt | Full-time | On-site At  Think Human , we care about ideas that make people stop, look, and feel something. We’re growing our creative team in Egypt and looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who loves turning ideas into strong, memorable visuals someone with a great eye for design, a curious mind, and the confidence to bring their own creative perspective to the table. You’ll be working across different brands, industries, and creative challenges, so no two days will look exactly the same. One day you might be developing a campaign key visual, the next shaping a brand identity or creating content for a social-first idea. If you enjoy agency life, love good design, and are always looking for ways to make the work better, we’d love to meet you. What you will be doing Turning briefs and ideas into strong, thoughtful, and beautifully crafted designs. Creating key visuals, campaign concepts, brand identities, social content, digital assets, presentations, and print materials. Taking ideas from early visual exploration all the way through to final execution. Working closely with Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Social Media, Strategy, Client Partnership, and Production teams. Bringing your ideas and point of view into brainstorms, campaigns, and pitches not just waiting for a layout to land on your desk. Making sure every piece of work feels consistent with the brand while still finding opportunities to push the creative. Juggling different projects and brands without compromising on quality or attention to detail. Keeping an eye on what’s happening in design, culture, technology, and the creative industry. Sharing your experience with junior designers and helping the wider creative team produce stronger work. What we're looking for ✔ 6+ years of experience in graphic design, ideally within an advertising, creative, or marketing agency. ✔ A portfolio that makes us want to keep scrolling — showing great ideas, strong craft, and a clear understanding of design. ✔ Excellent skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign. Experience with After Effects is a plus. ✔ A strong eye for typography, composition, layout, color, and visual storytelling. ✔ Experience developing campaign concepts, key visuals, branding, social media content, and digital creative. ✔ Someone who can take a brief, understand the bigger idea behind it, and turn it into something visually exciting. ✔ Comfortable working across multiple projects, brands, and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. ✔ Collaborative, open to feedback, and equally comfortable giving constructive creative input. ✔ Most importantly, someone who cares about the work  who notices the details, asks questions, brings ideas, and always wants to make the final output better. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to make things look good, but wants to make work that has an idea behind it. Sounds like you? We’d love to see your portfolio and get to know you.

review_candidates.description: Company Description: The Wellness is a specialist within leisure, hospitality and wellness industries that demonstrated its expertise and progressiveness over the past decade. Our success has been shaped by hard work, innovative solutions, a design driven mindset and the ability to overcome challenges, serving as a catalyst for our continues growth. The Wellness, we believe that design goes beyond mere structures, it is an art form that shapes the way we live, work, and interact with our surroundings. With a deep understanding of the built environment and an unwavering commitment. Our team of skilled architects and designers are driven by passion we curate meaningful and timeless wellbeing journeys for all aspects of life. Role Description: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Mechanical BIM Modeler responsible for creating, developing, updating, and maintaining detailed Mechanical BIM models based on approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements. The role is primarily focused on BIM modeling, model accuracy, detailing, documentation, and coordination support, ensuring that models follow project BIM standards and are suitable for design coordination and construction documentation. Engineering design, calculations, and engineering consultancy are not part of this role. Key Responsibilities: Develop detailed MEP BIM models (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) using Revit based on approved drawings, specifications, and design inputs. Prepare coordinated MEP models in alignment with architectural and structural models. Perform clash detection and coordination using BIM coordination tools and resolve clashes in collaboration with other disciplines. Generate MEP shop drawings, layouts, sections, schedules, and details from BIM models. Update and revise models based on design changes, RFIs, site conditions, and coordination outcomes. Support quantity take-offs and BOQ extraction from MEP BIM models when required. Ensure compliance with project BIM Execution Plan (BEP), company BIM standards, and client requirements. Participate in BIM coordination meetings and provide technical BIM support to the project team. Maintain organized model structure, naming conventions, version control, and documentation. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience as an MEP BIM Modeler. Strong proficiency in Revit MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing). Experience with Navisworks for clash detection and coordination. Good understanding of MEP systems, construction drawings. Ability to meet deadlines and handle multiple tasks efficiently. Proficiency in English is a must. What We Offer: A collaborative and supportive work environment. Opportunities for career growth and professional development. Competitive salary and benefits package. How to Apply: If you meet the above criteria and are excited about this opportunity, please send your resume to injy.ibrahim@thewellness.ae with " Mechanical BIM Modeler " in the subject line. Please note that this is a full-time, Egypt-based position.

review_candidates.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you'll spend your time writing code. You'll work with partner technical teams and end users to understand what they actually need, then design and build the solution yourself: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment. You'll be close enough to the mission to see why the problem matters, and you'll ship fast, because what you build gets used in the field almost immediately. Once a solution proves itself, you'll work with our core platform team to fold the durable parts back into the product, so your work keeps paying off beyond the deployment you built it for. Responsibilities Design and build software applications that solve specific operational problems for our partners, owning them end-to-end from architecture through deployment. Take loosely defined, real-world requirements from partner militaries and organizations and turn them into working software, often on tight timelines. Build interfaces and connectors between our platforms and partner systems, and validate data flows end-to-end in the field. Deploy your solutions on site, gather feedback directly from operators, and iterate quickly based on what you see working (or not) in practice. Spot patterns and capabilities worth building into the core product, and work with our platform engineering team to get them there. Debug issues in live operational settings, drive them to resolution, and document what you learn along the way. Build real working relationships with client technical teams and end users so you understand their problems well enough to solve them properly. Requirements 4+ years building and shipping production software, in Python and at least one lower-level language (C++, Rust, Go). A track record of defining and building end-to-end systems: projects, internships, or early-career work where you took an ambiguous problem to a working, deployed solution. Comfortable owning software end-to-end — design, build, debug, deploy — including on Linux, in operational or field conditions. Confident and clear communicating with client technical teams and senior stakeholders, with a bias to action Practical under constraint: ill-defined problems, tight deadlines, and a working solution over a theoretically perfect one. Travel: frequent on site with partners, domestic and international. Proficiency in English is mandatory. Nice to have Prior forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering experience. Depth in computer vision, deep learning, mission planning, robotics, or embedded software. Degree from a leading engineering school. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
